## Description

Please include a summary of the changes and which issue is fixed. Ensure that this PR does exactly ONE thing to keep our history pristine, as mandated by our agent guidelines.

Fixes # (issue)

## Type of change

Please delete options that are not relevant.

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Refactor (code improvement without functional change)
- [ ] Documentation update

## Checklist:

- [ ] My commit messages follow Conventional Commits (e.g. `feat:`, `fix:`, `refactor:`).
- [ ] This PR does exactly ONE thing.
- [ ] I have added/updated tests via `pytest` to cover these changes.
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code.
- [ ] If this work was delegated to AI, the branch is prefixed with `jules/` or `agent/`.
- [ ] Jules or another authorized agent/reviewer has reviewed the PR before merging.
